title: bardolier config set output
description: What a write to the config file (cli-spec.md §8) did. Preferences (app-spec.md §12) writes the SSD path and the terminal here so those settings have one source rather than a copy in the app's defaults.

created.description: True when the file did not exist before this call.

changed.description: Keys whose stored value actually changed. Empty means the write was a no-op.

overrides.description: Environment variables that overrode a value, e.g. BARDOLIER_ROOT. A key named here cannot be changed by writing the file — the app says so rather than appearing to succeed.

effective_config.description: Every settable §8 key, resolved. Paths are absolute and tilde-expanded. Roots are a separate, list-valued surface (`bardolier root add | remove | list`) and are not reported here. This block is duplicated verbatim in config-get and config-set; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.

catalogue_path.description: null when unset — the §4.1 fallback chain applies.
